title: Buyer Direct Card Payment of the Plan Premium — Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
A buyer may pay part of the plan premium of a Real Estate Service Contracts buyer-only order directly by card before closing; the card payment is posted against the plan invoice that is open on the order, and whatever it leaves open on that invoice remains payable through escrow at closing.

**Prerequisite.** A buyer's direct payment toward the plan premium is taken only after the order's billing history carries a plan invoice that no plan-change credit memo offsets.

Put another way, the direct payment waits on the order's billing history showing a plan invoice that is not offset by a plan-change credit memo; while every plan invoice on the order is offset by such a credit memo, no direct payment is taken.

**Scope of direct payment.** The plan premium covers the whole buyer term and is invoiced once per order, a plan change before closing crediting that invoice and reissuing it; on a buyer-only order before closing the buyer may pay part of it directly by card up to the direct card limit, and only on such an order, while the rest of the premium on such an order and the whole premium on every other order remain payable through escrow at closing.

**Earlier buyer payments on a credited invoice.** A payment the buyer made toward a plan invoice that was later credited for a plan change on the same buyer-only order stays on that order and counts toward the reissued plan invoice instead of being refunded, and only for such a payment; every other credit balance remains refunded within the plan's refund processing period, in calendar days, to the party that paid the invoice, and escrow refunds still go to the buyer once the escrow file is closed.

## Invocation: `prepay_plan_invoice_by_card_13fdf553`

**Capability.** Pays, as the buyer, toward the plan premium invoice of the real estate plan before closing, by card; any part of the invoice not paid this way stays open on it. One call records one payment from the buyer, with payment method card, against the plan invoice named, dated today, for the amount given, and lowers the plan's invoice balance by that amount. A payment confirmation number is issued and returned; the payment then shows in the plan's billing history against that invoice.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `prepay_plan_invoice_by_card_13fdf553` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `realty_contract_id` | the real estate contract (plan) number of the buyer's order, as given to the customer by the Bridgewell representative | identifier text |
| `invoice_number` | the plan invoice number being paid, as shown on the open plan invoice in the plan's billing history and given to the customer by the Bridgewell representative | identifier text |
| `amount` | the amount to pay now | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents); recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries: `status` "paid" when the payment was recorded; `payment_reference`, the payment confirmation number (text); `invoice_number`, the plan invoice paid; `amount`, the amount of the payment in USD with 2 decimal places; `payment_method` "card"; `entry_date`, today's posting date as YYYY-MM-DD; `invoice_balance`, the plan's invoice balance after the payment in USD with 2 decimal places.
